title: Functoriality of the torsor description of H^1
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and use, for abelian sheaves on the small Zariski site $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-zariski-site], the canonical bijection $H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G)\cong\{\text{isomorphism classes of }G\text{-torsors}\}$ of [lem-sc-torsor-h1] (Zariski case; torsors as in [def-sc-gm-torsor], cohomology as in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]). (1) For a morphism $\varphi:G\to G'$ of abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$, the induced map $H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G)\to H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G')$ sends the class of a $G$-torsor $T$ to the class of the $G'$-torsor $T\wedge^{G}G'$, the sheafification of $(T\times G')/G$ with $g\cdot(t,g')=(g\cdot t,\varphi(g)^{-1}g')$ and $G'$ acting on the second factor. (2) For a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] and an abelian sheaf $F$ on $Z_{\mathrm{Zar}}$, the natural isomorphism $H^1(Z_{\mathrm{Zar}},F)\cong H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},i_*F)$ of [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] sends the class of an $F$-torsor $T$ to the class of the $i_*F$-torsor $i_*T$.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 02FQ (cohomology-lemma-torsors-h1) and its proof (the class of a torsor as the boundary of 1 in the pushout extension), with Lemma 02UV (cohomology-lemma-cohomology-and-closed-immersions); naturality implicit in Varieties Lemma 09NY proof

proof.text: Choose for the $G$-torsor $T$ an extension $0\to G\to E\to\mathbf Z_X\to0$ whose fibre over $1$ is $T$ [lem-sc-torsor-h1-boundary-representative]. Its class is $\delta_E(1)$. Push out the extension along $\varphi:G\to G'$ [lem-sc-torsor-h1-ext-pushout]. The natural long exact cohomology sequences [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] of the morphism from the original extension to its pushout give $H^1(\varphi)(\delta_E(1))=\delta_{E_{\varphi}}(1)$; both quotient maps are the identity of $\mathbf Z_X$.

source.place: Lemma 02FQ, boundary of 1 for the extension and naturality of the cohomology long exact sequence

proof.text: The fibre over $1$ of $E_{\varphi}$ is $T\wedge^G G'$ [lem-sc-torsor-h1-ext-pushout]. Applying the converse clause of [lem-sc-torsor-h1-boundary-representative] to this extension identifies $\delta_{E_{\varphi}}(1)$ with the class of that fibre, proving (1).

source.place: Lemma 02FQ, pushout extension and fibre over 1

proof.text: For (2), choose an extension $0\to F\to E\to\mathbf Z_Z\to0$ representing $T$ by [lem-sc-torsor-h1-boundary-representative] on $Z$. Its class is $\delta_E(1)$. Exact direct image and the compatibility of the comparison isomorphism with connecting maps [lem-sc-closed-pushforward-boundary-naturality] send this class to the boundary of $1$ for the pullback along $u:\mathbf Z_X\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ of $0\to i_*F\to i_*E\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z\to0$. The pullback is required because $i_*\mathbf Z_Z$ is generally different from $\mathbf Z_X$.

source.place: Lemmas 02FQ and 02UV, connecting map and exact closed direct image

proof.text: The fibre over $1$ of that pulled-back extension is $i_*T$ [lem-sc-torsor-h1-ext-pushforward]. By the converse clause of [lem-sc-torsor-h1-boundary-representative] on $X$, its boundary of $1$ is the class of $i_*T$. Combined with Step 3 this proves (2).

source.place: Lemmas 02FQ and 02UV, fibre of the pullback and torsor class
